title: They work okay, but questionable origins and manufacturing
text: They work okay, but questionable origins and manufacturing. These are listed on Amazon  as being from the manufacturer HOOJO, but they are clearly marked VTOPMART on the bottom. Some of them have measurement markers on the side, some don't.  All in all, they seem to seal okay. It takes a while to get them lined up compared to other brands such as SISTEMA.  My main concern is that I question the true origin of this product, given the inconsistencies.  They are not specifically labeled as BPA free, but are marked as PP and code 5, which indicates BPA free polypropylene.  But - they are also marked as originating from VTOPMART....
